extracted.name: Ranch-Style Popcorn Seasoning
extracted.description: This ranch-style popcorn seasoning recipe combines herbs and spices like onion powder, garlic powder, dill, salt, and pepper for a flavor reminiscent of your favorite dressing.
instruction_lines: Combine onion powder, dill, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and vegetable oil in a small bowl.
